*Knock Knock*

You open the door to your apartment and see a young woman standing in the hallway. She's wearing a grimy tank-top and cut-off jean shorts. Her long brown hair is tangled and unwashed, and her large brown eyes look up at you pleadingly from above dark circles. Her pale skin has a waxy cast, and though her arms are wrapped protectively around herself, you recognize the tell-tale track marks of a junky.

"Hey," she says in a shaky voice, "I heard you could help me out. I need a fix, bad. You holdin'?"
